profiles.boundary: The retained generator output is a finite baseline. It is not a runtime advertisement or permission observation.
Command advertisement, executor context, inherited permission predicates and results remain unobserved.
Session-specific advertised syntax and denied/allowed execution remain unobserved; missing permission fields do not imply authorization.
Operator permission levels, source-kind predicates, advertised trees and execution remain unobserved.
Pack membership does not establish activation, custom-resource acceptance, tag resolution or reload precedence.
Each embedded pack identity and pack.mcmeta is retained separately; enabled flags do not prove its active-session behavior.
The generated OpenRPC document does not prove server enablement, transport, authentication or authorization.

non_enumerated_obligations.reason: Unknown fields, numeric/NBT widths, versioned envelopes, recovery and Java round trips need primary codec witnesses and actual observations beyond default reports.
Packet membership cannot enumerate malformed frames, encryption/auth predicates, reentrancy or malicious-input isolation.
World ownership, configuration, clean saves, failure recovery and operational APIs have no complete registry instance space.
The seven existing implementation gates require ordering, correctness, throughput/latency and resource observations on an identified build and host.
Enumerated IDs cannot establish ordinary survival progression, multiplayer interactions or cross-system persistence and timing.
Arbitrary custom schemas, inline/direct holders, authored opaque custom data and component patch/removal forms are not enumerated by shipped defaults.

Dragon subparts, generic factory fallback, block-to-BE attachment, menu/storage roles and initial/live privacy require independent source-backed relations. None are inferred from generated registry membership.
Finite shipped worldgen inputs do not enumerate fixed-seed ordering or stochastic outcomes; sampling and reference observations remain necessary.
All existing required family scenarios and strict/strict-all evidence gates remain authoritative. This bounded inventory cannot replace their acceptance.

limits: Only exact retained generated reports, all item report files, and all non-directory data/ members of the pinned inner JAR are enumerated. The sole data/.mcassetsroot metadata exclusion is recorded with bytes/hash.
Static registries retain report-level IDs/defaults and entry IDs. They do not enumerate all dynamic entries, factories, AI or codec payloads.
Block state IDs are source IDs, not array indices. Property domains/default tuples are retained; shapes, ticks, interactions, loot and block-entity associations remain open.

All command nodes, including executable parents, are retained once. Redirects remain graph edges. Parser properties, exact permission ASTs and ancestor chains remain source data, not numeric-level or authorization claims.

Resources preserve base/embedded pack identity, archive path, namespace, nested descriptor kind, bytes and observed type discriminators. Shipped instances cannot enumerate all accepted custom values, references, activation or reload semantics.
All 155 registry descriptors plus function/structure survive even without shipped instances. Descriptor flags do not constitute accepted codec schemas.

All 1658 default maps and 23072 component values are fingerprinted. The 69 observed component types are examples; 53 of 122 have none. Saved/wire widths, hashes, default elision, removal, opaque custom data and direct-holder forms remain separate open obligations.
All 260 reported packet IDs across five states are inventoried. Fields, framing, dispatch and gameplay effects are not inferred.

All 89 OpenRPC methods and 14 named schemas are retained. Internal refs resolve to source hashes. This is separate from incoming/outgoing RPC registry membership and does not prove enablement/auth/execution.

Version 1 deliberately records only open or exact-source-justified not-applicable dispositions. Classes are reusable obligation templates, not assertions of implementation equivalence. Implementation/evidence attachments are rejected. A future positive-coverage path must reuse the existing evidence validator with exact member/facet/profile/parameter/engine-build binding.
Unknown source fields are diagnostic; unexplained mappings are unmapped, explicit gaps are open, and justified exclusions are not_applicable. None can become implementation_present or paired_covered.

Complete inventory means complete accounting for these pinned surfaces with the reported open obligations and these limits. It never means all possible vanilla behavior inventoried, implemented or paired-verified.

review_provenance.scope: Optional design-review provenance only. These paths are never opened by the generator.
